capabilities: find unlinked mentions of the open note's title and aliases across the vault
match Arabic prefixes, diacritics, tatweel, dropped hamza and Persian letter variants with a stated reason
link mentions after preview and confirmation, with undo and per-mention ignore
configure per-note behavior via properties like wasl: exact, wasl: indefinite and aliases
run offline on mobile with an Arabic or English interface
extras: No AI and no network access; matching limits are documented in detail, with synthetic test metrics (83/84) and a 41%-of-mentions estimate that the author flags as preliminary. Warns when Obsidian's 'Automatically update internal links' setting is off. Android is untried; only iPhone tested.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in unlinked mentions look for the name literally, so it catches none of the three.
motivation: The author had notes whose titles appeared in other notes with Arabic prefixes and spelling variation that Obsidian's unlinked mentions never caught.
problem: Obsidian's built-in unlinked mentions match titles literally, so Arabic spelling variation like prefixes, diacritics or tatweel hides mentions it never finds.

relations.evidence: Obsidian's built-in unlinked mentions look for the name literally, so it catches none of the three.

summary: Arabic-aware unlinked-mentions finder that suggests links for note titles with prefixes, diacritics or tatweel, linking only on approval.
